Tour.WouldYouLike: Would you like some guidance on how to use Keyring?
Tour.AddAndShareDescription: To add and use credentials you scan a QR code displayed by the service provider.
Tour.AddCredentialsDescription: Add credentials by scanning a QR code displayed on the issuer service.
Tour.NotificationsDescription: After you scan a QR code, the credential offer or proof request will appear here, as well as other notable events.
Tour.YourCredentialsDescription: Your added digital credentials appear here. You can review credential details and add and delete credentials.
Tour.CredentialOffersDescription: An organization has offered you a credential. Review the credentials details and choose to accept or decline it. Accepted credentials will be added to your wallet.
Tour.ProofRequestsDescription: An organization is asking you to prove your credentials. Review what they're asking for and choose to accept or decline it.
Tour.ContactOffersDescription: Add contacts by scanning a QR code or sharing your own code. Contacts can send you credentials and messages.
Tour.WitnessIconDescription: Tap the shield icon here to view your witness connection. A witness verifies credential exchanges between contacts at events, adding an extra layer of trust.

CameraDisclosure.CameraDisclosure: The camera is used to scan QR codes that initiate a credential offer or credential request. No information about the images is stored, used for analytics, or shared.

Invited.IntroTitle: Tell the admin who to invite
Invited.IntroBody: To invite you to {{community}}, its admin needs your identity for that community. Your agent makes it now — you confirm with your face or fingerprint — and then you send it to the admin.
Invited.ConfirmBody: Your agent makes your identity for {{community}} — the one its admin will invite.
Invited.ShareStepTitle: Send this to the community's admin
Invited.ShareStepBody: Send it any way you like: a message, an email, AirDrop. The admin of {{community}} uses it to invite you.
Invited.WaitingBody: When the admin of {{community}} sends you an invitation link, open it on this phone or paste it here. It will show up on this screen.
Invited.ArrivedBody: {{community}} invited you. Join to get your membership card.
Invited.JoinedBody: Your membership card is in your wallet.

Join.WhichBody: Scan or paste the community's link — or a vetter's ticket, which names the community too.
Join.Unnamed: This community hasn't published a name
Join.NameFromLink: Name as provided by the link you used
Join.AsksStatements_one: A statement from one of its vetters, who checks it is you in person
Join.AsksStatements_other: Statements from {{count}} of its vetters, who check it is you in person
Join.AsksLegalName: Your legal name, checked by the vetter
Join.AsksInvitationOnly: It admits people by invitation only. Ask its admin to invite you.
Join.AsksNext: You'll meet a vetter, who gives you a ticket link or code.
Join.ConfirmBody: Your agent makes a new identity for {{community}}.
Join.NeedsAgent: Link your agent first — it keeps your identity for each community.
Join.AsksOther: It asks for credentials it describes as:
Join.AsksNothing: It doesn't ask for anything — you can apply straight away.
Join.MakeIdentityBody: {{community}} gets a new identity made just for it by your agent. You confirm with your face or fingerprint.
Join.AsBody: {{community}} gets a new identity made just for it. Your profile fills in its name, once — nothing else is linked.
Join.AsBodyUnnamed: This community gets a new identity made just for it. Your profile fills in its name, once — nothing else is linked.
Join.AsNoProfile: You don't have a profile yet — create one below, or type your name when you meet the vetter.
Join.FromProfile: From your {{profile}} profile — correct it here if your legal name differs.
Join.FromYourProfile: From your profile — correct it here if your legal name differs.
Join.CreateProfileHint: A new profile just for this — its details go into the identity once.

MyAgent.Title: Your agent
MyAgent.WhatItIs: An agent holds your identity for a community and carries messages to it. You need one before you can join or be vetted.
MyAgent.Authenticating: Signing in and opening a channel…
MyAgent.NotConfigured: No agent is configured for this build.
MyAgent.NoIdentity: No identity yet. Create one to share with a community's admin, or to apply.
MyAgent.CreatingIdentity: Asking your agent for an identity…
MyAgent.ShareIdentity: Share this with the community's admin to be invited.
MyAgent.NoInvitations: No invitations. When an admin invites you, it appears here.
MyAgent.AddedToWallet: Membership card added to your wallet.
MyAgent.InvitationNotForYou: This invitation was issued to another identity.
MyAgent.NoApprovals: Nothing to approve. When your agent needs your consent, it asks here.
MyAgent.AwaitingConsent: Waiting for an approver to consent to {{task}}…
MyAgent.AgentListening: Your agent can reach you here.
MyAgent.EnrolHint: Share this identity with your agent's operator to enrol this phone. Then connect.
MyAgent.ConnectExplains: Connecting signs in to your agent, prepares your identity for the community, and opens the channel to it.

Vetting.Title: Vetting
Vetting.RowHint: Be vetted by a member, or vet someone if you are a vetter.
Vetting.NeedIdentity: You need an identity for this community first — every card, statement and the final application name the same one.
Vetting.ReadAloud: Read this code to the person, or…
Vetting.OrScan: …let them scan or paste this link
Vetting.DeskEmpty: No requests yet. Hand someone a ticket.
Vetting.MatchCodeHint: Read this code aloud — both screens must show the same one.
Vetting.Attest: I checked the person and their document — attest
Vetting.LegalNamePlaceholder: As on your passport or ID
Vetting.FaceNote: This is what the vetter will see and check against your document.
Vetting.Discounted: {{n}} statement(s) will not count — the vetter's grant did not cover the moment they signed, or has since been revoked.
Vetting.GrantUnchecked: {{n}} vetter's grant could not be checked just now. You can still apply; the community will check it when you do.
Vetting.IndependenceCapped: More statements from people who declared a {{relationships}} connection to you than this community counts. Your application still stands — someone will review it.
Vetting.UnreadableMaxAge: This community publishes an age limit for statements ({{value}}) that this app could not read, so the count above may be more hopeful than the community's.
Vetting.ProfileHint: Publish this so people looking for a vetter can find you. Your grant works either way.
Vetting.ProfileNamePlaceholder: How you want to be listed
Vetting.MatchQuestionApplicant: Does the vetter's screen show the same code?
Vetting.MatchQuestionVetter: Does their screen show the same code?
Vetting.CodesDifferEnded: The last session ended without a statement. If the codes differed, tell the vetter and ask for a new ticket.
Vetting.WaitingForVetter: Waiting for the vetter to open the session…
Vetting.WaitingForStatement: The vetter is checking your document…
Vetting.CheckTheirId: Check their ID — does it say this?
Vetting.ConfirmSendTitle: Send your name to the vetter
Vetting.ConfirmSendBody: The vetter sees the legal name you entered and checks it against your ID. Nothing else is shared.
Vetting.ConfirmAttestBody: You confirm you checked this person's ID yourself and that it shows the name on their card.
Vetting.ConfirmApplyBody: Your vetting statements go to the community, which decides whether you join.
Vetting.CardPreview: Your card will show: legal name “{{name}}”. Nothing leaves until you send it.

Status.accepted: Accepted — waiting for the vetter to open the session
Status.cardSent: Card sent — the vetter is checking

Vetting.SeatVetterHint: A member sits in front of you. You hand them a ticket, open the session, check their card against their document, and attest.
Vetting.StandingRevoked: Your vetter role was taken away.
Vetting.StandingExpired: Your vetter role has run out.
Vetting.StandingNotYet: Your vetter role hasn't started yet.
Vetting.StandingAsk: Ask an admin to grant you the vetter role again. Until then you cannot vet anyone here.
Vetting.StandingNoTicket: Until then you cannot start a vetting: a new ticket would begin something that cannot finish.
Vetting.ReadingHeld: Reading what this phone already holds…
Vetting.SeatApplicantHint: A vetter checks who you are. You ask them with their ticket, read the match code, send your card, and receive their statement.
Vetting.HeroVetter: You hold a vetter grant for this community. Open the desk to cut a ticket and vet the person in front of you.
Vetting.HeroApplicant: Be vetted in person by a member, then apply to the community with their statement.
Vetting.SubmissionDeferred: The community asked for more: {{needs}}. Your application stays open — gather what is missing and send it again, or withdraw it.
Vetting.SubmissionPending: You've applied — it's with the community, waiting on their decision. You can still withdraw it.
Vetting.SubmissionWithdrawn: You withdrew your application. You can apply again.
Vetting.SubmissionDecided: The community has decided your application ({{effect}}).
Vetting.WithdrawNothingOpen: There was no open application to withdraw — you can apply.
Vetting.AlreadyApplied: You'd already applied to this community — here is where that application stands.

Errors.NoAnswer: Your agent didn't answer. Tap Continue to try again — this usually works the second time.
Errors.NotAllowed: Your agent wouldn't allow that. Ask its admin whether this phone still has access.
Errors.Unreachable: Nothing answered at that address. Check your connection, then try again.
Errors.Unknown: That didn't work, and the app doesn't know why. Try again; if it keeps happening, send us the details below.
